prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Gadolinium (Gd) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — gadolinium: a silvery-white rare-earth metal named through the black mineral gadolinite for a Finnish chemist, first seen in 1880 and named in 1886; it is magnetic like iron only when cool and lets go just above room temperature, around 20 degrees; it warms as it is pulled into a magnet and chills when released, the heart of magnetic refrigeration; it brightens the body's water in MRI scans and captures neutrons better than any other stable element — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

observations: One adult woman; source-world face, eyes and hair colour retained.
Visible limbs attach naturally; no extra arms, legs or detached hands observed.

acceptance: User approved generation, commits and normal main publication; preserve generated output.
